units.source_text: “那种人谁知道会住在哪儿呢，少爷。

en.t: Who knows where people like that will be staying, young master.

units.source_text: 什么今天晚上，哪有固定的住处哟。

en.t: Tonight? They do not have any fixed place to stay.

units.source_text: 哪儿有客人，就住在哪儿呗。”

en.t: Wherever there are customers, that is where they stay.
